Platforms: Windows, Public Cloud
This event provides key metadata regarding images (AMIs, AKIs, and ARIs) available in AWS. CrowdStrike retrieves this information by processing the
response from AWS's DescribeImages API [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeImages.html] on your behalf.
This event is only generated for Discover for AWS [/support/documentation/10/falcon-discover-feature-guide] customers. It's generated either when Discover
for AWS observes new or related activity via CloudTrail or during Discover for AWS's weekly full scan.
